tag.vi: 🎉 Tối nay đi tiệc: lấp lánh và nhanh

occasion: You are going to a party tonight (prom or a friend's birthday).
constraints: You want sparkle: gems and a bright colour. You must leave in 45 minutes, so you check the time and ask how long it will take. You are happy when the stylist gives a clear time and suggests a design that fits it.
openingLine: Hi! I have a party tonight and I need something sparkly. Can you finish in 45 minutes?
